verdict.rationale: 2FAS's own homepage lists Apple Watch support as a feature, which implies a first-party watch surface for 2FAS Auth. However, that is one thin marketing line that never says codes can be viewed on the watch without the phone. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that TOTP codes display on the watch, Wear OS or other smartwatch support, setup or sync details for the watch app, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an everyday user, I can read my codes from my smartwatch without pulling out my phone

citations.quote: Apple Watch Improved convenience and accessibility.
